description: Per-component text fields for the prestige theme. The dashboard /create + /update pages render form inputs per field. The AI brand generator reads this recipe to know what copy to emit. The theme runtime reads brand.text[<key>] first, falls back to defaults below.

sections.label: Header — announcement & top bar
sections.description: Slim chrome above the main header. Use to advertise key benefits.

fields.label: Announcement bar text
fields.default: Appointment-only {cityish} showroom · Finance from competitive rates · Nationwide delivery available
fields.aiHint: Short 3-part scrolling line emphasising the dealership's USPs. Use the tokens {cityish}, {city} where relevant. Pipe-separated with middot · for visual rhythm.

sections.label: Home page hero
sections.description: Largest above-the-fold copy block — title, lead, search CTA.

fields.label: Hero eyebrow line
fields.default: The {cityish} Edition · {year}
fields.aiHint: Editorial eyebrow with city + year. Magazine-style framing.

fields.label: Hero title — main line
fields.default: Hand-picked stock,
fields.aiHint: Bold uppercase declarative statement about the dealer's value proposition. ALL-CAPS display.

fields.label: Hero title — italic accent
fields.default: honestly sold.
fields.aiHint: Short italic finisher in serif font. The clincher that completes the title.

fields.label: Hero lead paragraph
fields.default: {tagline}. {streetLine ? 'Appointment-only showroom on ' + streetLine : 'Appointment-only showroom'} with finance, warranty, part-exchange and nationwide delivery — no pressure, just the right cars.
fields.aiHint: Editorial body paragraph for the hero. Mention the brand's care + transparency + the showroom location if available. Avoid fluff.

fields.label: Hero search button label
fields.default: Browse stock
fields.aiHint: Primary CTA button label inside the hero search form.

sections.label: Edition strip (under hero)
sections.description: Decorative magazine-edition strip with three short labels.

fields.label: Left label
fields.default: Volume 03 · {cityish} Edition

fields.label: Centre label
fields.default: The {brandName} Curation

fields.label: Right label
fields.default: {year} · {postcode}

sections.label: Trust band — 4 reasons to buy
sections.description: The 4-card band on the homepage explaining what makes the dealer different.

fields.label: Reason 1 — title
fields.default: Hand-picked stock

fields.label: Reason 1 — detail
fields.default: Every car driven, photographed and HPI-checked before listing.

fields.label: Reason 2 — title
fields.default: Finance from competitive rates

fields.label: Reason 2 — detail
fields.default: PCP / HP via FCA-regulated lenders. Soft-search, no impact.

fields.label: Reason 3 — title
fields.default: Independent warranty

fields.label: Reason 3 — detail
fields.default: 3 / 6 / 12-month options. Service plans available.

fields.label: Reason 4 — title
fields.default: Nationwide delivery

fields.label: Reason 4 — detail
fields.default: Doorstep handover anywhere in the UK. Test-drive included.

sections.label: Pull quote (homepage + about)
sections.description: Big italic quote with founder attribution.

fields.label: Quote text
fields.default: “We don’t sell from a script. The car is either right for you, or it isn’t — and we tell you which.”
fields.aiHint: Founder / dealer principal voice in first person. Should sound like a real person, not marketing copy. Include curly quotes.

fields.label: Attribution
fields.default: — {brandName} team · {cityish}
fields.aiHint: Em-dash + name + role + location. Format: '— Name, role · City'.

sections.label: Footer
sections.description: Brand description in the footer column + appointment note.

fields.label: Footer brand description
fields.default: Appointment-only used car and van showroom in {cityish}. Hand-picked stock, transparent valuations, finance from competitive rates, and nationwide delivery.

fields.label: Appointment note
fields.default: By appointment only · Mon–Sat 09:30 – 17:30

fields.label: About hero title
fields.default: A {cityish} independent built on referrals.
fields.aiHint: Editorial title. Lead with the city + 'independent' framing or substitute a stronger value proposition.

fields.label: About hero lead
fields.default: We don’t do volume targets, pushy upsells or hidden admin fees. We buy carefully, photograph honestly, and sell to people who appreciate the difference.

fields.label: Story section eyebrow
fields.default: The story so far

fields.label: Story title
fields.default: Run by people, not algorithms.

fields.label: Story paragraph 1
fields.default: {brandName} began on the back of a simple observation: too many used-car buyers feel like they’re being managed rather than helped. We set up the {streetLine ? streetLine + ' showroom' : 'showroom'} as an appointment-only space so every customer gets a proper hour with us — and not a queue.

fields.label: Story paragraph 2
fields.default: Every car on the forecourt is bought by us, inspected by our prep team, photographed in natural light, and listed with the warts described. If a car has a chip or a service-history gap, you’ll read about it in the listing — not discover it on a test drive.

fields.label: Contact hero title
fields.default: Visit the showroom — by appointment only.

fields.label: Contact hero lead
fields.default: {streetLine}, {city}. Book a slot and we’ll have the car prepped, fueled and ready for you.

fields.label: Finance hero title
fields.default: Finance from regulated lenders, not pressured salespeople.

fields.label: Finance hero lead
fields.default: PCP, HP and Lease through a panel of FCA-regulated UK lenders. We share the rates upfront and never inflate APRs to chase commission.

fields.label: FCA disclaimer paragraph
fields.default: {brandName} is an Appointed Representative of an FCA-authorised credit broker, not a lender. Finance subject to status and affordability. Representative APRs vary by lender, vehicle and credit profile. 18+ UK residents only. Written quotations available on request.
fields.aiHint: Legal-style FCA disclaimer. Must include the brand name as the Appointed Representative and the standard 'subject to status' phrasing.

fields.label: Sell-your-car hero title
fields.default: The {cityish} showroom buys cars — paid in cleared funds.

fields.label: Sell-your-car hero lead
fields.default: Three quick steps, an honest inspection and BACS payment on collection. We don’t auction, we don’t commission-creep.
